design_system.gallery.usage.ai-mobile-na: All four 390 × 64 source compositions have working local controls and keyboard-accessible popovers.
Add project stores the entered name only in component state. Escape closes the popover, Enter or Ctrl/Cmd+Enter confirms.
design_system.gallery.usage.ai-sidebar.d: All four source sidebar variants render using the presentational Sidebar without application API calls.
Search filters the local history, navigation updates the selected item, and new chat creates a local draft counter.
The collapsed logo expands the sidebar; this adds a keyboard-accessible restoration control to the source composition.
design_system.gallery.usage.alert.do.0: Current API only: status (error/warning/success/information/feature) + style (filled/light/lighter/stroke) + size.
design_system.gallery.usage.alert.do.1: light/lighter for inline page notices; filled for high-emphasis moments.
design_system.gallery.usage.alert.dont.0: The legacy variant prop is deprecated — lint flags it.
design_system.gallery.usage.alert.dont.1: Never build ad-hoc colored notice boxes; this is the primitive for them.
design_system.gallery.usage.avatar.do.0: Use src for photos, Memoji, and illustrations; use label for initials or icon for an entity symbol.
design_system.gallery.usage.avatar.do.1: Numeric sizes reproduce all nine Figma diameters: 20, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 72, and 80 px. Legacy xs/sm/md/lg/xl sizes remain 20/28/36/48/64 px.
design_system.gallery.usage.avatar.do.2: Numeric 20–32 px initials use one letter; 40–80 px use two. Font size, line height, and medium weight follow the source. The application font and tracking remain governed by existing tokens.
design_system.gallery.usage.avatar.do.3: Photo stacks use the audited size-specific overlaps. Initial stacks reduce overlap where two letters need more room, and full overflow counts can widen beyond the avatar diameter.
design_system.gallery.usage.avatar.do.4: The six top-status examples use the existing circular badge slot and semantic colors. They show supported compositions, not an exact replica of the Figma verified silhouette.
design_system.gallery.usage.avatar.do.5: Local James Brown assets come from Figma nodes 246:11135, 246:11139, and 246:11141. The production image crop can differ from Figma.
Do not assume square avatars or simultaneous top and bottom decorations are supported by the current API.
Do not render interactive actions inside the decorative badge slot; put actions in a separate button.
design_system.gallery.usage.badge.do.0: Counts and short semantic labels; the brand variant for custom-view and renewal pills.
design_system.gallery.usage.badge.do.1: Semantic variants (success/warning/info/neutral/error) come from status tokens — no custom colors.
design_system.gallery.usage.badge.do.2: Four appearances and ten color families; numeric sizes16/20 follow measured source dimensions. Named sizes and semantic status palettes retain application defaults; new category fills use measured Figma colors with accessible text.
design_system.gallery.usage.badge.dont.0: Not for system statuses (use StatusBadge) or user-applied labels (use Tag).
design_system.gallery.usage.brand-colors: Use the brand-violet 10/30/100 pattern (bg/border/text) for AI features and user-saved views.
Do not substitute brand colors for semantic status tokens.
Do not repurpose accent-indigo — it is the selection-control contract.
design_system.gallery.usage.button-group: Numeric sizes coordinate child dimensions at 24, 32, or 36 px. Legacy size names keep their behavior.
The 15 source groups cover quantities two through six at all three sizes. Item examples include text, leading, trailing, both, and icon-only content.
design_system.gallery.usage.button.do.0: One default (primary) Button per view; remaining actions step down to outline, ghost or muted.
design_system.gallery.usage.button.do.1: Destructive actions use the destructive family; -outline/-soft/-ghost lower the emphasis without losing the semantics.
design_system.gallery.usage.button.do.2: Default height is h-9; sm (h-8) in dense toolbars, 2xs only inside table rows.
design_system.gallery.usage.button.do.3: primary-filled represents the indigo CTA retained in overlay instance 472:831, using the darker status-info-solid role for readable white text in both themes. The current main Button set lists Neutral and Error only; this instance is not a new Code Connect axis.
design_system.gallery.usage.button.do.4: For a pending action, compose Spinner with disabled and aria-busy; Button has no loading prop.
Never Button size="icon" for icon-only actions — use IconButton (correct sizing + aria-label contract).
Never style a raw <button> or <Link> to look like a Button.
The link variant is for navigation-like actions, not for mutations.
design_system.gallery.usage.chart-palett: Never build token class names dynamically (`bg-chart-${n}`) — the Tailwind scanner only sees complete literals, so the class is silently never generated.
A role is a surface paired with its content color — always use them together, never mix pairs.
Click a card to copy both classes of the pair.
Never put foreground on a surface from a different pair — contrast is only tested within a pair.
Never use a -foreground token as a standalone accent color.
design_system.gallery.usage.color-tokens: Pair every surface with its -foreground counterpart.
Borders come from border-border / border-input — nothing else.
Never border-gray-* or any raw palette shade.
design_system.gallery.usage.command-menu: The source Small (48) label is inaccurate: all six small rows measure 40 px. The larger rows measure 64 px. Numeric sizes opt into these measurements; unsized rows keep the legacy layout.
Basic, Avatar, Left Icon, Brand, Company and Country use real source assets or production primitives. Keyboard selection updates the result and closes the palette.
Search and clear stay synchronized. Group captions and actions flow together without overlapping long headings; the footer includes real keyboard hints and a local help action.
design_system.gallery.usage.compact-butt: Compact icon actions at 20 or 24 px with 18 or 20 px icons. Four appearances support 6 px and full-radius shapes.
Each matrix exposes every size, appearance, and radius combination. Hover and press enabled buttons; active examples are controlled toggles and disabled examples use native disabled.
Supply an accessible name and enough space around dense actions. Modifiable inherits foreground; its hover surface uses the existing 15% opacity scale rather than the source 16%.
design_system.gallery.usage.corner-radiu: The scale derives from the --radius base token (10px): sm 6px, md 8px, lg 10px, xl 16px.
Cards and panels use rounded-lg; controls, chips and filter buttons use rounded-md.
rounded-full is reserved for Badge, Tag, SegmentedControl, Avatar and status dots.
No arbitrary values (rounded-[24px]) — pick from the scale.
No full-pill radii on filter chips or custom controls outside the reserved primitives.
A searchable, keyboard-operated picker built from Popover and cmdk. All six leading types use source assets and production components at 36 or 56 px.
Search, clear, choose with arrows and Enter, or dismiss with Escape. The selected value and footer action update local example state.
The saved checked state is separate from the active keyboard option. Footer buttons remain outside listbox options. Source Misc Items 414:8031 supplies search, action and caption layouts.
design_system.gallery.usage.file-format-: Both sizes and all nine category colors come from Figma. Teal is the source name of the light-blue category.
The original Figma paper/fold artwork is bundled locally. Category-label foregrounds meet 4.5:1 contrast.
design_system.gallery.usage.file-upload-: Cancel/remove and retry are real callbacks. The error example retries using local simulated progress.
The caller owns transfer state, progress, and localized file-size text.
Default and hover are live states of the same drop target. Select or drop files to exercise the local demo queue.
Pass onFilesSelected and handle transfer separately. Demo progress is simulated locally; files never leave the browser.
Keep custom accept/maxSizeBytes and the description consistent.
Always pass aria-label — the icon is the only content.
size="default" is h-8, one step smaller than Button; use size="lg" (h-9) to align inside a Button row.
Never fake it with Button size="icon".
design_system.gallery.usage.icon-registr: size-4 inside buttons, menus and inline text; size-5 in section navs and toolbars.
Always aria-hidden next to a visible label, or aria-label on icon-only controls.
Color with semantic tokens only (text-muted-foreground, text-status-*-icon).
Icon-only actions use IconButton — it ships the focus ring, sizing and the aria-label contract.
No emoji or font glyphs as icons — Lucide only.
Never convey status by icon color alone; pair with text or a label.
No hand-drawn SVGs when a Lucide icon exists.
design_system.gallery.usage.image-upload: Figma calls the layout with text above actions Vertical; both source layouts place the avatar to the left.
New selections must decode as PNG/JPEG and meet the configured minimum dimensions (400×400 by default). The caller owns the preview URL and transfer.
Existing uploaded illustrations are exact source fixtures. Change and Remove update only local browser state.
design_system.gallery.usage.input.do.0: Numeric sizes 32, 36 and 40 use the source 14/20 text, 20 px icons and asymmetric input padding. Named sizes preserve existing callers.
design_system.gallery.usage.input.do.1: leading and trailing accept interactive controls; provide accessible labels and forward disabled to those controls. leftIcon/rightIcon remain decorative.
design_system.gallery.usage.input.do.2: The source compositions cover all twelve Text Input types. Hover and focus are real browser states; the Date example uses the native date picker and locale formatting. Existing CardInput brand badges and phone parsing retain their runtime behavior.
design_system.gallery.usage.landing-anno: Use one concise message and one relevant action at the top of a landing page.
Keep the dismiss action available; on small screens preserve the action and shorten the message.
Do not use promotional announcements for form errors or critical system alerts.
design_system.gallery.usage.motion.do.0: The Figma duration scale is 150, 200, 300, 400 and 500ms; choose timing according to content size and travel distance.
design_system.gallery.usage.motion.do.1: Name the changing property and respect reduced-motion preferences.
Do not use animation as the only feedback for a state change.
Do not use transition-all when only one property changes.
design_system.gallery.usage.password-str: Supply the evaluated strength and requirements from the policy that owns the form.
The interactive example demonstrates the three rules shown in Figma; the visual primitive does not define authentication policy.
design_system.gallery.usage.phone-number: Numeric sizes 32/36/40 add source geometry while the existing automatic height remains the default.
Choose a country or edit the national number to update the local value. Validation and optional duplicate lookup retain their existing contracts.
countries translates and limits picker choices; countryLabel names the picker and renderCountryIcon can supply actual country assets.
Desktop and mobile compositions expose all 18 source variants through real hover and focus states.
Enter saves a local draft; Shift+Enter inserts a line break. Attachments stay in this browser and can be removed.
Model names reproduce source labels. These examples do not call a model or represent a subscription.
design_system.gallery.usage.rating-bar.d: Use the five-part feedback scale with a translated group label.
The feedback-area composition joins the scale to a Textarea and keeps both controls independently accessible.
Do not use this feedback scale for unrelated actions; use ButtonGroup for actions.
toolbarDesign opts into source layouts 01–04 with 28 px controls, 20 px icons and 6 px item radii. Existing full, standard, basic and minimal presets retain their defaults.
Every source layout includes a working More menu. Hidden commands remain available in that menu when the toolbar narrows.
The 12-color palette already includes the source Color11 (white) and Color12 (black). Color choice changes editable content; stored HTML still passes through the existing sanitizer.
The character counter updates while typing. onChange retains its blur contract; consumers supply translated labels and their own comment and mention workflows.
design_system.gallery.usage.select.do.0: Six source leading types: Basic, Country, Avatar, Provider, Brand, and Company. The 32/36/40 numeric sizes use the measured source text, icons, padding and radii; named sizes retain their existing defaults.
design_system.gallery.usage.select.do.1: SelectItem leading keeps the visual outside Radix ItemText. The trigger renders its selected visual explicitly, so a selection never duplicates the icon.
design_system.gallery.usage.select.do.2: Use Dropdown for searchable choices. Select keeps Radix keyboard typeahead; search inputs must not be nested in a Select listbox.
design_system.gallery.usage.separator.do: The nine Figma Content Divider layouts are represented: line, line spacing, text and line, text only, solid text, icon button, icon button group, text button, and text button group.
Place action buttons between two flexible Separator rules with gap-2.5. ButtonGroup supplies joined borders; do not place interactive controls inside a separator role.
Vertical, dashed, and label-alignment examples expose the existing code API beyond the nine Figma layouts.
Compositions use production tokens and responsive width. The labeled primitive remains 12/16 px; the audited Figma text-and-line label is 11/12 px.
design_system.gallery.usage.shadows.do.0: Use shadow-xs for controls, shadow-sm for cards and higher elevations for overlays.
design_system.gallery.usage.shadows.do.1: Keep the visible keyboard focus supplied by DS primitives. Shadow tokens adapt to the active theme.
design_system.gallery.usage.shadows.dont: Do not draw custom colored glows or arbitrary box shadows.
Do not remove focus feedback without an equivalent visible indicator.
design_system.gallery.usage.sidebar.do.0: Presentational composition with local state; the application AppShell still owns tenant APIs and injection points.
design_system.gallery.usage.sidebar.do.1: Hover, current navigation, workspace switching, filtering and feature-card actions use real controls.
design_system.gallery.usage.sidebar.do.2: Feature-card primary and neutral surfaces use the existing accessible application palettes; they do not claim exact Figma color parity.
design_system.gallery.usage.social-butto: All seven source providers appear in Filled and Stroke, with text or icon-only content. Buttons are 40 px high; icon-only buttons are 40 px square.
Supply the logo as content and an accessible name for icon-only buttons. These local source assets do not invoke authentication.
Stroke uses semantic foreground and border tokens; monochrome logos follow foreground in both themes. Native hover and keyboard focus expose the interaction states.
design_system.gallery.usage.spacing.do.0: Use the 4px spacing grid. Start with gap-2 between controls, p-4 within containers and p-6 for larger panels.
design_system.gallery.usage.spacing.dont: Do not invent arbitrary spacing values or compensate for layout problems with negative margins.
design_system.gallery.usage.state-tokens: Pair -bg with -text of the same family — the shades are contrast-tested together.
-icon for glyphs and dots, -border for outlines; both handle dark mode themselves.
Alert status="feature" uses the neutral token family; brand-violet is reserved for AI and saved-view accents.
Never hardcode Tailwind status colors (text-red-*, bg-green-*, text-amber-*).
No dark: overrides on status tokens — they already theme.
design_system.gallery.usage.status-badge: System-computed statuses (active, pending, failed) — drive variants through a shared StatusMap.
The dot makes state scannable in dense tables.
Not for user-applied labels or categories — that is Tag.
design_system.gallery.usage.tabs.do.0: variant="underline" is the canon for page-level tab strips; pill only for small embedded switchers.
design_system.gallery.usage.tabs.do.1: TabsList always carries an aria-label; use count and leading to add context to triggers.
design_system.gallery.usage.tabs.dont.0: No hand-rolled tab strips from buttons and border classes — lint flags raw tab lists.
design_system.gallery.usage.tag.do.0: User-applied labels and categories; map domain types via TagMap for consistency.
design_system.gallery.usage.tag.dont.0: Not for system status — that is StatusBadge.
appearance=source adds the source 112 px minimum field, 12 px radius, 14/20 text and an interior character counter. The browser-native resize handle remains operable.
The default appearance and external counter retain their current layout. Set maxLength together with showCount and supply a visible field label.
design_system.gallery.usage.typography.d: Use font-sans for the interface and font-mono for code and identifiers. Both resolve through the host application font tokens, with system fallbacks in globals.css.
Use text-2xl for backend page titles and text-sm for body text. Scale measurements assume a 16px root font size.
The Figma reference uses Inter / Inter Display; these specimens show the shipped font tokens rather than claiming font parity.
Do not copy marketing display sizes into dense backend pages.
Do not set inline font families or arbitrary text sizes.
